research.question: What WCAG 2.2 requires of a success result shown without moving focus, of inactive component contrast, and of focus order when the focused element is removed.
research.reason: UX-1 and UX-7 rest on WCAG success criteria.

sources.title: Understanding SC 4.1.3: Status Messages (WCAG 2.2)
sources.claim: A success result shown without moving focus is a status message and must be programmatically determinable; role=status is a sufficient technique.

sources.title: Understanding SC 1.4.3: Contrast (Minimum) (WCAG 2.2)
sources.claim: Text in inactive user interface components has no contrast requirement.

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.4.3: Focus Order (WCAG 2.2)
sources.claim: The criterion does not address the removal of the focused element.

research.summary: A success result shown without a focus change is a status message (role=status); inactive components have no text contrast requirement; focus order does not address a removed element.
research.limitations: Accessed 2026-10-14; the focus recommendation is interpretation.
